about: Step 4 of sheet RA-A (version 6): a fix over RA-A-4, the cabinet's right side, as the Lead asked at 13:07 on 19 November and confirmed at 13:24. RA-A-3 painted the cabinet's frame down its left side and along its bottom but not its right: its top bar, with the second orange light, and the breaker rows' cables fade softly into the wall at about x 505 to 540, y 630 to 885. One masked edit of RA-A-4, a narrow mask from just inside the breaker rows' right ends to about 15 px past the cabinet's outline on the wall, the cabinet's full height. Picture pixels of the 1024 x 1536 painting; a rectangle holds the pixels whose x and y lie in its ranges, both ends included.

picture.name: RA-A-4

stepOne.name: RA-A-1
stepOne.use: the start picture of the cabinet's refreshed lift (lift4), as step 2's lift was

measured.on: RA-A-4, by brightness profiles across the cabinet's right side

breakerRowsRightEnd.how: the breaker bodies of rows one and two are bright (mean of R, G and B above 130) in at least a fifth of their rows up to x 515, and in under a sixth from x 516; row three ends at the same column, darker

secondLight.how: its warm orange pixels (R above 190, G 70 to 190, B under 120, R minus B above 100)

wallFrom.how: from x 552 leftward, the first column more than 35 from the wall's median brightness is x 536 to 538 in most rows (the cables' outer edge and the top bar's faded end)

cabinetOutlineRight.how: version 4's stage outline of the cabinet (its front face's right edge, y 653 to 853 there); step 2's mask grew it 6 px, to x 537

grilleEdge.how: featuresA.json's grille, whose rim starts at x 553 (y 705 to 861): the dark seam of its panel; the seam runs the wall's full height

mask.why: Left edge: just inside the breaker rows' right ends (x 515), so the seam falls on the breakers' own edge. Right edge: 15 px past the cabinet's outline (x 531), on plain wall, 6 px short of the grille's seam. Top and bottom: the cabinet's full height with room for its frame's corners: from the top of step 2's mask at the cabinet (y 636) to y 883, so that the pipe run, which drops to y 899 just past the mask's right edge, is 15 clear pixels away on the square measure.

frameRule.how: on the rows beside the grille (y 705 to 861): a pixel departs from the wall when its brightness (the mean of R, G and B) is more than 35 from the median of the unchanged wall just outside the mask in its row (x 547 to 552, five rows); the frame's outer edge is the rightmost column of the mask in which at least half of those rows depart, so that a vertical frame counts and the wall's seams, scratches and clamp tips, which cross few rows, do not
frameRule.why: The Lead: the new frame edge meets the 15 px rule against the grille, whose edge is at x 553: the frame's outer outline at x 537 or less leaves at least 15 clear pixels. The mask's wall beyond it is there so that the frame's outline and the wall meet cleanly; the wall stays unchanged.

fixText: The masked area holds the right side of the open electrical cabinet on the back wall.
The cabinet's heavy steel frame continues down its right side and closes the right end of its top bar, matching its left side, with rivets and a crisp drawn outline.
The second orange light stays whole, inside the frame.
The wall to its right stays unchanged.
